name: dapp-certificado-transformacion
description: Green Foot - trazabilidad multi-material y emision de Certificado de Transformacion (ERC20) sobre Polygon, con indexer y API sobre PostgreSQL

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,indexer,web -c blue,yellow,green "npm run dev:api --workspace=packages/backend" "npm run dev:indexer --workspace=packages/backend" "npm run dev --workspace=packages/frontend"
scripts.ci: npm run contracts:compile && npm run contracts:test && npm run backend:typecheck && npm run backend:lint && npm run frontend:typecheck && npm run frontend:lint
